login.heading: Welcome <highlight>back</highlight>! 👋
login.lead: Ready to pick up where you left off?
body: Your lectures, your summaries and everything you have learned are waiting in one place.
With Munsit AI, your journey toward deeper understanding and smarter studying continues.

register.heading: Your smarter journey starts <highlight>here!</highlight> 🚀
register.lead: Every lecture is a chance to understand more.
body: Create your Munsit AI account and turn your lectures into clear summaries, organized notes and easier review.
Start today, and make every piece of information count.

recovery.heading: No worries, <highlight>we'll get you</highlight> back! 🔐
body: In a few simple steps you will recover your account and return to your lectures, summaries and notes right where you left off.
Everything you have learned is waiting for you.

success.heading: Your account has been created

forgot.heading: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Don't worry. Enter your email and we will send you a link to reset your password.

sent.heading: Link sent!
sent.body: We sent the reset link to your email. Check your inbox, and your spam folder if you can't find it.

reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.description: Enter your new password and confirm it to continue.

updated.heading: Your password has been changed
updated.body: You can now sign in with your new password.

invalidLink.heading: Invalid reset link
invalidLink.body: This link is not valid or has already been used. Request a new link to continue.

expiredLink.heading: This link has expired
expiredLink.body: This link has expired. Request a new link to set your password.

validation.passwordRules: The password does not meet the requirements.

errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect. Try again.

failed.register: We couldn't create your account. Try again.
failed.forgot: We couldn't send the reset link. Try again.
failed.reset: Something went wrong while changing your password. Try again.
